improvements.problem: Leading 'Pol δ' label stays frozen at left (~x415, y240) while the polymerase travels to (~x730, y210); the label is >2 grid units from its enzyme and sits on the left end of the mid-frame duplex ladder.
improvements.solution: Bind the leading polymerase label to dna_polymerase_leading and place it below the enzyme, clear of the duplex rung row: self.place_at_grid(pol_delta_leading_label, 'D6', scale_factor=0.7) with a per-frame offset so it tracks the enzyme's x (stay within column 5-6, row D).

improvements.problem: Lagging 'Pol δ' (~x535, y248) and 'Ligase' (~x585, y245) captions are printed directly on top of the mid-frame duplex ladder rungs (y237-247), making both text and ladder illegible.
improvements.solution: Move both captions into the empty band between the duplex and the Okazaki fragments: self.place_at_grid(pol_delta_lagging_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.6) nudged to y~288 (just under dna_polymerase_lagging, above fragment tops at y296), and self.place_at_grid(ligase_label, 'D5', scale_factor=0.6) at (~x640, y278) beside dna_ligase; no overlap with the D6 leading label.

improvements.problem: Nascent-strand polarity glyphs are drawn on the template lines (orange 3' at ~405,162; green 3' at ~740,160; green 3' at ~467,320), visually merging template and new-strand ends.
improvements.solution: Offset each polarity glyph onto its own strand row, off the blue template lines: self.place_at_grid(rna_primer_3prime_label, 'C3', scale_factor=0.6) at (~x405, y172) above the orange primer row; self.place_at_grid(new_leading_3prime_label, 'C6', scale_factor=0.6) at (~x740, y192) below the green leading row; self.place_at_grid(new_lagging_3prime_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.6) at (~x467, y310) above the bottom template, left of the fragments.

issues.suggested_change: Re-anchor the leading 'Pol δ' caption to the enzyme and place it at grid D6, scale_factor=0.7, following the enzyme horizontally so it never rests on the duplex ladder row.

current_state.overlapped_geometry: duplex ladder rungs spanning x460-790, y237-247

issues.suggested_change: Drop the lagging 'Pol δ' caption to D4 (~y288, scale 0.6) directly beneath dna_polymerase_lagging and above the Okazaki fragment tops, and shift the 'Ligase' caption to D5 (~x640, y278, scale 0.6) next to dna_ligase; both stay within 1 grid unit of their enzymes and off the ladder.

current_state.problem: all three glyphs sit on the blue template lines (y~160 and y~320)

issues.suggested_change: Keep polarity values unchanged but relocate glyphs onto their nascent rows: primer 3' to C3 (~405,172), leading 3' to C6 (~740,192), lagging 3' to D4 (~467,310), each scale_factor=0.6, so template vs nascent ends remain visually distinct.
